scientific_integrity: A complete analytic lattice-point formula reduces the finite sharp-threshold claim to 49 explicitly enumerated exact rational Ehrhart coefficient vectors. All files, proof, and checker refer to this one claim. The finite certificate is not extrapolated to higher dimensions.
scientific_limitations: Sharp cutoff only for polar duals of complete-bipartite symmetric edge polytopes through dimension thirteen; ordinary monomial Ehrhart positivity, not magic positivity; higher dimensions and other graph classes not classified. The newest relevant preprint could be assessed from its public abstract, but its full text was unavailable. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: The first non-Ehrhart-positive complete-bipartite polar edge polytope
